title: APR: Compact Analytic-Prior Repair for Traffic-Sign Detection — Software and Research Example
description: Frozen APR-HardSelect-96 inference modules, selected RGB-only given-sign-ROI locator architecture, tensor-only model weights, and one attributed noncommercial DFG research example. Reported aggregates are drawn from the accepted IEEE CSIT 2026 paper.
notes: License by component: self-authored code MIT; original documentation and aggregate tables CC-BY-4.0; released model weights and DFG-derived example CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. Paper 066 accepted and orally presented at IEEE CSIT 2026; final proceedings identifier pending.
